descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary This role ensures that assembling work complies with safety regulations and supports operational efficiency. Job Responsibilities
• Finish assigned work on time with good quality and high productivity in pump assembly area.
• Familiar and follow up the safety and environment (EHS) regulation in daily work, reporting any potential EHS related risk issues to the supervisor
• Strictly follow up the manufacturing process document and standard working instruction in operation time.
• Document work performed and materials used.
• Collaborate with other technicians and departments. Qualifications
• At least 3 years working experience in mechanical industry. Familiar with mechanical industry and product.
• Can read machining drawing.
• Able to operate bridge crane is preferred.
• Able to use general measuring tool, e.g. micrometer, dial indicator, caliper and so on.
• Willingness to learn and follow procedures.
• Physical stamina and attention to detail. What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
